blind.description: A small potted orchid consisting of a smooth, spherical white ceramic pot with a thin gold decorative band around its middle. Dark green, fleshy oval leaves fan out from the soil inside the pot, supporting a thin arched stem displaying several pale peach/cream orchid blossoms with pinkish-red centers. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and realistic with no detached or floating pieces.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of spreading dark green oval leaves flanking an arch of delicate pale orchid blossoms, with its distinct flower-and-leaf shadow cast onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the figure (roughly 12 to 14 inches tall) and less than 1 foot wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.77x off the catalog (1.1 x 0.6 ft)
